notes.subject: taim toktok bilong olgeta i kalapap kamap
notes.rationale: כשמע לעדתם — 'olsem kongregesen bilong ol i harim' (KJV) o 'taim mi harim ol i sanap olgeta' (BSB) — gramar i allowim tupela.

notes.subject: balus na net
notes.rationale: v11 i tokim Efraim olsem balus, v12 Yahwe i bekim wantaim net bilong ketchim ol pisin — piksa i go het.

translation: Taim ol i wokabaut i go, bai mi sparim net bilong mi antap long ol; olsem ol pisin bilong skai, bai mi pulim ol i go daun; bai mi skelim ol, taim toktok bilong olgeta i kalapap kamap.

tokens.gloss: bai mi pulim ol i go daun
toktok bilong olgeta i kalapap kamap
